title: Comboni’s call
content:
Lied auf Youtube anhören

At the back of my mind
there's a cross bathed in light
"Go!" a voice says to me,
"Bring this light to those in darkness".

From the Cross the light is shining, Comboni said:
"Oh Africa, you' ve the right to be Church
Otherwise what's the use of my faith?
Yes I'll go because..."

At the back of my mind
there's a cross bathed in light
"Go!" a voice says to me,
"Bring this light to those in darkness".

2.
"You young man are simply dreaming,"
some men advised.
"Of those who' ve tried many failed or else died
Knowing this why should you risk your life?"
"I will go because..."

At the back of my mind
there's a cross bathed in light
"Go!" a voice says to me,
"Bring this light to those in darkness".

3.
"You young man, are really dreaming,"
some people said,
"Just listen now to the voice of the wise
Can't you see, there's no hope for that land?"
I'll still go because…

At the back of my mind
there's a cross bathed in light
"Go!" a voice says to me,
"Bring this light to those in darkness".

4.
"God is life and He will help me," Comboni said,
"He sends me now and I go without fear
Death may come but God is more powerful.
So I'll go because..."

At the back of my mind
there's a cross bathed in light
"Go!" a voice says to me,
"Bring this light to those in darkness".

5.
Sickness came and darkness fell, Comboni said:
"My time is up, fruit is ripe, do not fear.
You my friends carry on, it's God's work!"
We'll go on because...

At the back of my mind
there's a cross bathed in light
"Go!" a voice says to us,
"Bring this light to those in darkness".
